component.name: Chip
component.description: Compact priority/status pill using component chip tokens aliasing semantic status colors (danger, warning, info, success). Independent from list rows; compose inside Action List Item, filters, or tables.

antiPatterns.reason: Chip reinforces priority; entire row tint overloads hierarchy.

contentRules: Keep label to one short word or two words max.
Default Action List labels: urgent=Requerido, high=Pendiente, normal=Próximo, low=Info.
Use component/chip/status tokens for bg and text; these alias semantic status color decisions.

rules: urgent maps to component/chip/status/danger; high to warning; normal to info; low to success.
Labels are content, not color names; Action List uses Requerido, Pendiente, Próximo, Info.
Padding and radius are bound to component/chip/base/* variables.
Typography: Label Small + typography/label/sm-semibold/fontSize + fontWeight/semibold binding.

accessibility.role: text or img when icon added later
accessibility.keyboardSupport: Not interactive by default; parent row handles focus.
accessibility.screenReader: Chip label should restate priority when color alone is insufficient.
accessibility.wcag: AA text on semantic status backgrounds

aiHints.context: Prefer composing Chip instances rather than drawing pill fills inside parent components.
